$comment: Baseline of QUEUED, human-owned design-token contrast issues. audit-checks classifies each color-contrast violation against these signatures: a match is tagged `queued` (already logged for a foundation decision — do NOT re-verify per component), anything else is a NEW finding that needs review. Match is by foreground hex (and background hex when given), case-insensitive. See the audit PRs that queued these.

contrast.label: destructive button ink
contrast.note: White-on-#e5484d = 3.91 < 4.5 on an interactive control. Queued (button). Proposed --on-tone ink.

contrast.label: badge soft warning ink
contrast.note: Warning soft-tone text on soft background fails AA in light. Queued (badge). Proposed --on-tone ink.

contrast.label: destructive message ink (light)
contrast.note: text-destructive validation/error message on the light app background = 3.62 < 4.5 AA. Recurring across form-field error text (password-input, otp-input Error stories, and any component that renders `text-destructive` copy). Same --destructive tone family already queued for button ink; the fix is a foundation-token decision (darken --destructive in light, or introduce a dedicated --destructive-text / --on-tone ink) — do NOT patch per component. Queued for human confirmation.

contrast.label: severity ramp soft/outline ink — critical
contrast.note: --sev-critical used as Badge soft/outline TEXT ink on light tinted/app backgrounds fails AA (~2.7:1). Same Badge soft/outline tone-ink family already queued in badge batch 1 ('soft tone-text light 1.6–3.0 → propose --on-tone ink'). Surfaces through every Badge-derived severity component (severity-badge, cve-reference-chip, …). Foundation-token decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp soft/outline ink — high
contrast.note: --sev-high as Badge soft/outline TEXT ink on light fails AA (~2.3:1). Badge tone-ink family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp soft/outline ink — low
contrast.note: --sev-low as Badge soft/outline TEXT ink on light fails AA (~2.6:1). Badge tone-ink family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp soft/outline ink — info
contrast.note: --sev-info (neutral) as Badge soft/outline TEXT ink on light may fail AA. Badge tone-ink family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp solid ink — white on critical
contrast.note: Badge SOLID variant: white ink on --sev-critical = 3.45 < 4.5 AA (both themes; sev tokens are theme-invariant). Same 'solid white-on-tone' Badge family queued in badge batch 1. Resolved by the --on-tone ink foundation decision — do NOT patch per component (severity-badge, cve-reference-chip, …).

contrast.label: severity ramp solid ink — white on high
contrast.note: Badge SOLID variant: white ink on --sev-high = 2.50 < 4.5 AA. 'solid white-on-tone' Badge family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation --on-tone decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp solid ink — white on medium
contrast.note: Badge SOLID variant: white ink on --sev-medium = 1.91 < 4.5 AA. 'solid white-on-tone' Badge family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation --on-tone decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp solid ink — white on low
contrast.note: Badge SOLID variant: white ink on --sev-low fails AA. 'solid white-on-tone' Badge family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation --on-tone decision — do NOT patch per component.

contrast.label: severity ramp solid ink — white on info
contrast.note: Badge SOLID variant: white ink on --sev-info fails AA. 'solid white-on-tone' Badge family queued in badge batch 1. Foundation --on-tone decision — do NOT patch per component.
